verdict.rationale: Graphite delivers AI-generated insights and suggestions on your code and PR data inside the product. AI reviews analyze every PR and suggest fixes. Graphite Chat summarizes changes, highlights potential issues, diagnoses failing CI checks using CI context, and offers one-click suggested fixes from the review page. missing for 10: AI-generated insights across aggregate team data (the Insights productivity dashboard is not described as AI-powered), independent hands-on corroboration of how useful the AI suggestions are.
